name: mbp-05-palsson-benchmark

purpose.question:
Configured with operating conditions matched to the 2025 Palsson lab
high-density E. coli study, does the v2ecoli ↔ pbg-bioreactordesign
coupled model **render a structured comparison report** (sim-vs-
published overlays + categorized divergences + open questions) on
the published WT batch-phase prefix trajectories, suitable to feed
mbp-06's gap-analysis synthesis?

Investigation-level note: the original question framing ("match within
tolerance") was reframed 2026-05-26 to "render a structured comparison."
The success definition is whether the comparison was EXECUTED AND
REPORTED COHERENTLY, not whether biology matched. All biological
divergences feed mbp-06 unchanged.
purpose.mechanism:
The benchmark paper is Beulig et al. 2025 (mSystems 10(7),
doi:10.1128/msystems.00323-25; senior author B. Palsson), titled
"Trade-off between resistance and persistence in high cell density
cultures." Open access, PDF at
`references/papers/Beulig_2025_mSystems_high_cell_density.pdf`;
extracted metadata + scope notes at
`references/expert/palsson_2025_fed_batch.md`. Digitized trajectories
at `references/papers/palsson-2025-supp/`.

Two-stage batch → fed-batch fermentation to 50–80 gDW/L in parallel
well-controlled bioreactors; exponential feeding after batch-to-fed-
batch transition (t=0 h); >470 transcriptomic samples across five
strain groups (WT BW25113, 31 SGKO, TRP, TRPp, MEL) and four
fermentation phases (I–IV).

For mbp-05, scope is WT only and (until fed-batch lands in
pbg-bioreactordesign) the BATCH PHASE PREFIX. Configure the mbp-03/04
coupled composite to the published operating profile (reactor geometry,
aeration, medium, initial conditions). Run; render comparison overlays
for every sim ↔ published trajectory pair listed in `comparison_overlays`
below (~8 surfaces); categorize divergences in the report card across
four categories (v2ecoli metabolic deficiency / coupling-adapter
limitation / experimental uncertainty / placeholder-induced).

**No new model capability.** model_change is empty. The comparison
harness (`req-2-comparison-harness`) is generic over the
`comparison_overlays` config — adding a new comparison = adding one
YAML entry. Future investigations reuse the harness with their own
list.

Transcriptional-state matching against the >470 transcriptomes is a
natural extension (v2ecoli outputs transcript counts) — out of mbp-05
scope; pre-seeded as mbp-09 candidate-future-study in mbp-06.
purpose.expected_outcome:
For each entry in `comparison_overlays`, the harness produces a single
overlay panel + derived comparison metrics. The deliverable is the
report card: a markdown document with all overlay panels and a
structured `## Divergence triage` section enumerating divergences
against the four-category taxonomy, each pointing at the specific
sim path / published column / observation that drove the categorization.

Pass / fail of each test below is about whether the overlay+triage
artifact was produced — not whether biology matched. Divergences are
valuable: each one is a specific mbp-06 gap finding seed.

pipeline_gate.gate_status_summary:
Blocked on mbp-04 (multi-generation stability). Benchmark citation
confirmed (Beulig 2025 mSystems; PDF in references/papers/);
structured extraction of operating profile + trajectories from the
paper is a req-1 prerequisite. Terminal acceptance gate of the
investigation.
pipeline_gate.proceed_condition:
All comparison overlay panels rendered (one per `comparison_overlays`
entry); report.md committed with `## Divergence triage` section
populated against the four-category taxonomy. Divergences themselves
are PASSED to mbp-06 as input — they do not gate this phase. The
`divergences-categorized-in-report-card` test is the load-bearing
one (per chris_feedback_2026_05_26 §10).

model_change.notes:
EVALUATION PHASE — no new model capability. The previous
`operating_profile` / `published_trajectory_path` parameters were
misclassified as model_change (they're harness configuration, not
model state). Configuration of the harness lives in
`comparison_overlays` below. Knowledge ingestion (raw PDF + structured
extraction) is prerequisite work, tracked in req-1-palsson-ingestion
(already complete; see implementation_requirements).

key_assumptions: Published trajectories are digitizable / available at sufficient resolution to overlay.
OD600 ↔ gDW conversion factor (od_to_gdw, default 0.34 — Beulig 2025 value; was textbook 0.33; matches mbp-02 default) holds at Palsson's cell-density regime, or is refit from the paper.
If Palsson is fed-batch only, this study scopes to the batch-phase prefix until pbg-bioreactordesign gains fed-batch (deferred enhancement).
0D well-mixed assumption holds at the paper's reactor scale (bench).

open_questions.question:
How long is the batch phase in Beulig 2025 (t < 0 h before feed
onset)? Need this from the methods to set duration_min correctly.
Currently placeholder 480 min (8 h); paper likely 4–6 h batch.

Beulig measured 5 strain groups; OD600 ↔ gDW conversion may differ
per strain (especially MEL with growth arrest). For the WT-batch
comparison, is textbook 0.33 acceptable or does the paper supply a
WT-specific value?

Beulig provides >470 transcriptomes across phases I–IV — a unique
benchmark axis (v2ecoli outputs transcript counts; the upstream
multiscale-bioprocess plan's dFBA path does NOT). Should we open a
candidate-future-study now to scope transcriptional-state matching,
or defer until mbp-05 OD/biomass tests are at least drafted?

candidate_causes: Published CSV path wrong / missing — comparison_overlays entry mis-configured
Sim path doesn't exist in the run output (typo, removed in a refactor, identifier mismatch like LAC vs LACTATE)
Comparison harness errored during overlay generation
checks: Run harness in dry-mode: confirm each sim_path resolves in the run + each published_csv exists
Confirm units conversions in published_csv loader match the units declared in the overlay entry

failure_modes.signature: divergences-categorized-in-report-card FAILS — triage incomplete or unstructured
candidate_causes: Auto-comparison harness output is the only artifact; no expert triage entry recorded
Triage entries omit the four-category taxonomy
Triage entries omit the evidence pointer (specific sim_path + published_column)
checks: Confirm report.md contains a `## Divergence triage` section
Confirm each entry references one of: v2ecoli_metabolic_deficiency | coupling_adapter_limitation | experimental_uncertainty | placeholder_induced
Confirm each entry includes the evidence pointer in mbp-06-consumable form

limitations: EVALUATION PHASE (chris_feedback_2026_05_26 §10): mbp-05 deliberately does NOT make tolerance-based biology claims. The original framing (`end-of-run-od-matches-published` etc.) structurally encoded an open-ended menu of model knobs to turn — even with the 'no silent tuning' discipline, the impulse to tune to a tolerance-test was built into the test design. The reframe shifts the bound on the AI agent to 'execute and report'.
Single benchmark study; not a multi-dataset validation.
Fed-batch operations remain a deferred enhancement (pbg-bioreactordesign has no fed-batch yet); this study scopes to the BATCH-PHASE PREFIX of the Beulig dataset.

v2ecoli's calibration is slow-growth M9-glucose (~60-min doubling, single cell); the high-density 50–80 gDW/L regime is OUTSIDE the calibration envelope. Under the new framing this is no longer a 'tolerance must reflect this' caveat — it becomes one of the divergences mbp-06's gap analysis categorizes.
Strain scope: WT BW25113 only. SGKO (31 knockouts) / TRP / TRPp / MEL are deferred — natural candidate-future-studies under v2ecoli's variant scope.
Transcriptional-state matching against >470 Beulig transcriptomes is a unique benchmark axis (v2ecoli has transcripts; upstream dFBA path does not) — deferred to mbp-09 (pre-seeded in mbp-06).

implementation_requirements.title: Generic sim-vs-published comparison harness
implementation_requirements.description:
Iterates over the study's `comparison_overlays` list, for each entry:
  - Resolves `sim_path` against the run output (handles `aggregation:
    per_biomass` and any other reductions).
  - Loads `published_csv` and extracts `published_column`.
  - Renders an overlay panel (sim trajectory + published trajectory,
    time-aligned) → report/overlay_<name>.png
  - Computes per-overlay derived metrics (end-of-run value diff,
    shape-similarity, peak timing, etc. — keyed by the panel's
    `backs_tests`).
  - Categorizes any large divergences into the four-axis taxonomy in
    report/divergence_triage.md (with evidence pointer to the panel
    + sim_path + published_column).
The harness is GENERIC: adding a new comparison surface = adding one
`comparison_overlays` entry. No code change. Future investigations
reuse the harness with their own `comparison_overlays` list.

Framework-layer (chris_feedback_2026_05_26 §2): hoisting
`comparison_overlays` into pbg-superpowers schema is a deferred-upstream
candidate (tracked in mbp-06 axis-E gap entry).

preliminary_findings.summary:
REFINED 2026-05-29 after pulling the Beulig batch trajectories from
references/papers/palsson-2025-supp/. The Beulig BATCH PHASE peaks
at ~9.6 g/L (max OD ~28, OD×0.34) at ~13 h batch elapsed —
empirically from chart 10 (5 best-sampled reactors). The 50-80
gDW/L figure from the paper's abstract is the FED-BATCH endpoint,
not the batch endpoint. Charts 00 and 01 used the fed-batch figure
as the target band — that was an over-statement; charts 02 + 10
(which use the actual sampled batch trajectories) are the load-
bearing comparisons from now on.

At the actual scope (batch-phase prefix only), v2ecoli's cpa=1e9
run reaches 3.26e-3 g/L after 60 sim-min — about 1.5-2 orders of
magnitude below Beulig's actual batch trajectory at the same real
time, and ~3-4 orders below Beulig's batch peak (~9.6 g/L). The
single_daughters lineage convention caps total biomass at
cell_mass × cpa for ONE lineage; to match Beulig's batch peak at
cpa=1e9 each agent would need to be ~10 mg dry mass (vs the ~1 fg
v2ecoli simulates) — an architectural cap, not a tuning gap.

EMPIRICAL CONFIRMATION (2026-05-29): the
aggregator-cpa1e9-batch-prefix-multigen run targeted 6h but was
terminated at sim_min=175 (memory ceiling); the salvaged
trajectory shows v2ecoli's biomass OSCILLATING between ~1.2 mg/L
and ~4.3 mg/L across the division cycle, with NO accumulation
across generations. Chart 02 visualizes this plateau against
Beulig's batch climb to ~9.6 g/L — a 3.3-order gap that duration
cannot close. mbp-05 will surface this diagnostically; closing
it requires architectural moves (population composite with
counter-rather-than-single-daughters lineage tracking, or a
surrogate engine — both mbp-06 candidate-future-studies).
consequences: mbp-05 comparison harness will produce a DIAGNOSTIC report first (where v2ecoli sits relative to Beulig) BEFORE it produces an EVALUATIVE report (does v2ecoli reproduce Beulig). The diagnostic-first framing matches Chris's 2026-05-26 §10 reframe.
Closing the residual gap requires (a) longer batch duration, (b) impossibly-large cpa (~1e14), OR (c) fed-batch operations (deferred upstream pbg-bioreactor-transport-fork blocker).
The investigation's `cells_per_agent` representative-sampling architecture is necessary but not sufficient to reach Beulig density; the OD-only chart for low-OD runs makes that visible.
follow_ups: long-duration-batch-multigen (run baseline at sim_seconds=21600 / 6-h batch-phase prefix to see how far cell-mass-per-agent climbs before the single_daughters lineage chain saturates)

report.headline: Render a structured sim-vs-Beulig-2025 comparison (overlays + categorized divergences) on the WT batch-phase prefix; divergences feed mbp-06.
report.summary: EVALUATION phase (no new model capability): success = the comparison was EXECUTED AND REPORTED COHERENTLY, not that biology matched. Preliminary diagnostic finding (refined 2026-05-29): the Beulig BATCH PHASE peaks at ~9.6 g/L (max OD ~28 x 0.34); the 50-80 gDW/L abstract figure is the FED-BATCH endpoint. v2ecoli at cpa=1e9 plateaus ~4.3 mg/L per division cycle (single_daughters cap) — a ~3.3-order gap that is architectural, not a tuning gap. Full ~13-surface comparison overlays + four-category divergence triage pending the harness.

study_card.one_liner: Beulig 2025 high-cell-density benchmark — structured comparison + divergence triage.
study_card.deliverable: Comparison harness over comparison_overlays + report.md with ## Divergence triage (four-category taxonomy).

biological_summary: Benchmark: Beulig et al. 2025 (mSystems, doi:10.1128/msystems.00323-25; Palsson lab), two-stage batch->fed-batch to 50-80 gDW/L. mbp-05 scopes to WT, BATCH-PHASE PREFIX (Beulig batch peak ~9.6 g/L). Compared surfaces: OD600/biomass, glucose, acetate + mixed-acid byproducts (lactate/formate/ethanol/pyruvate/succinate), GUR, OTR/CTR, base addition. v2ecoli's calibration (slow-growth M9, single cell) is OUTSIDE the high-density envelope — divergences are EXPECTED outputs categorized for mbp-06, not failures.

literature_anchors.note: Beulig 2025 is the sole benchmark anchor. Batch peak ~9.6 g/L (charts 02, 10 — load-bearing); 50-80 gDW/L is the FED-BATCH endpoint (charts 00, 01 over-stated it -> marked SUPERSEDED). Behavior tests are process-level artifact_check (no numeric biology bands), so no band citations apply.

design_pivot_required.note: REFRAMED 2026-05-26 (chris_feedback_2026_05_26 §10) from "match within tolerance" to "render a structured comparison + categorize divergences". Removed all model_change/new_parameters (evaluation phase). Also corrected the Beulig target (2026-05-29): batch ~9.6 g/L vs the abstract's 50-80 gDW/L fed-batch endpoint.

conclusion_verdicts.statement: Preliminary charts quantify the v2ecoli-vs-Beulig batch-density gap: v2ecoli plateaus ~4.3 mg/L vs Beulig batch peak ~9.6 g/L (~3.3 orders), an architectural cap from single_daughters x cell_mass x cpa, not a tuning gap.
conclusion_verdicts.evidence: charts 02 + 10 (load-bearing), 03 (single vs both daughters); preliminary_findings v2ecoli-vs-beulig-density-gap-refined.

conclusion_verdicts.statement: Full comparison overlays (~13 surfaces) + four-category divergence triage not yet produced — awaits req-2 comparison harness; divergences will seed mbp-06 gaps.
